idea-plugin.name: Audit Log Retention Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Log retention lint for Loki, CloudWatch, ILM, S3 and Kubernetes audit YAML

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Audit Log Retention Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/audit-log-retention-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/audit-log-retention-lint

action.text: Audit Log Retention Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Audit Log Retention Lint on the file in the editor
